pages.title: Decay Chains
pages.text: $(thing)Decay Chains$()$(br2)Uranium becomes thorium, then radium, then radon, then polonium and at last lead - fourteen steps, each with its own half-life. Wait long enough and every step runs as fast as the slowest feeds it. Unlocks Radiogenic Lead and Lead Shielding.

$(thing)Insight$(): 40$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Radiochemistry.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Radium Salt.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A long-lived parent (half-life T _ 1) feeds a short-lived daughter (half-life T _ 2). After a while the daughter is made as fast as it decays and its amount stops changing. Write how many daughter nuclei M sit alongside N parent nuclei.
